name: No Icon Animations
description: Turn off the icon animation for each game mode you choose: cube, ship, ball, UFO, wave, robot, spider and swing copter. For example, with Cube selected the cube no longer rotates when it jumps. Visual only - gameplay and hitboxes are not changed.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn it off to get every animation back.

cube.name: Cube
cube.description: No jump rotation for the cube.

ufo.name: UFO
ufo.description: No tilting or wobble for the UFO.

wave.name: Wave
wave.description: No rotation for the wave icon when it goes up and down.

robot.name: Robot
robot.description: No running or jumping animation for the robot.

spider.name: Spider
spider.description: No running or jumping animation for the spider.

swing.name: Swing copter
swing.description: No tilting for the swing copter.
